description: The Java interface 'GatewayMapper' defines methods for mapping devices to their corresponding gateways, including a static factory method and a method for retrieving mapped gateway device IDs based on tenant and device IDs.

classes.name: GatewayMapper
classes.description: A Java interface that maps a given device to the gateway through which data was last published, providing a factory method and a method to determine the gateway device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a GatewayMapper using the default implementation, requiring factories for registration and device connection, and a tracer.

methods.name: getMappedGatewayDevice
methods.description: Method to determine the gateway device ID for a given device ID within a tenant, potentially returning the last known gateway, a 'via' entry, or the device ID itself, encapsulated in a Future.
